event.garage_band_walkout.title: A Walkout
event.garage_band_walkout.context: {{label}} has had enough. Nobody said when, and nobody is answering the phone.
event.garage_band_walkout.opt.walkout_me: They sit down, say the quiet part, and stay a band — for now.
event.garage_band_walkout.opt.walkout_ov: They take the deal. They are quieter in the room than before.
event.garage_band_walkout.opt.walkout_le: The last take belongs to whoever stayed.
event.viral_cover.title: An Unsanctioned Cover
event.viral_cover.context: Someone recorded {{label}} in a bedroom studio and it is spreading faster than anything you made.
Your name rides it. So does the resentment.
event.viral_cover.opt.cover_charge_fee.o: The money arrives. So does the story about you.
event.tour_bus_breakdown.title: The Bus Is Not Moving
event.tour_bus_breakdown.context: {{label}} is somewhere between towns with a broken bus and a promoter who does not appreciate excuses.
event.tour_bus_breakdown.opt.bus_emergen: Get them to the next date.
They play the date. They tell the promoter who paid.
event.tour_bus_breakdown.opt.bus_cancel_: Three promoters remember. One of them is the one you need.
event.reunion_rumor.kicker: BAND // OLD NAMES IN A NEW STORY
event.reunion_rumor.title: They Are Saying The Name Again
event.reunion_rumor.context: Someone saw {{label}} at a show that was not billed as a reunion. The rumour has your studio on it.
event.reunion_rumor.opt.rumor_pursue.lab: Book the room and make it real
event.reunion_rumor.opt.rumor_pursue.fla: Law of the Reunion: every breakup is a future payday.
event.reunion_rumor.opt.rumor_pursue.out: You pay for a room they may never fill. They fill it.
event.reunion_rumor.opt.rumor_ignore.out: By next month nobody is asking.
event.rival_diss_track.title: Somebody Answered
event.rival_diss_track.context: A rival studio has put out a record with your name in the credits of the complaint. The trade press noticed before you did.
event.rival_diss_track.opt.diss_ignore.o: It is still being played on the radio in March.
event.rival_diss_track.opt.diss_answer.o: The trade press now has two records and one story.
event.console_law_anecdote.title: Somebody Wrote Your Law Down
event.console_law_anecdote.context: An old engineer drops by with the sentence everyone in this room has been living by, and an invoice-free favour to go with it.
event.console_law_anecdote.opt.law_coffe: Nothing beats a story for free.
You leave with a better way to explain the room.
event.console_law_anecdote.opt.law_spare: He leaves with a drawer of valves. The rack runs cleaner.
event.venue_anniversary.title: An Anniversary Booking
event.venue_anniversary.context: The venue your era is built on is celebrating, and the only studio they called is yours.
event.venue_anniversary.opt.venue_take_s: Everyone who ever queued on that street is in one room.
event.venue_anniversary.opt.venue_send_r: They come back talking about it for a year.
event.award_nomination.title: You Have Been Nominated
event.award_nomination.context: Your name is on the shortlist, and {{label}} is the one who put it there.
event.award_nomination.opt.award_campaig: The trade notices you are playing the game. Then they vote.
event.award_nomination.opt.award_thank_c: The nomination goes nowhere. The relationship goes everywhere.
event.tube_stash_find.kicker: STUDIO // THE BACK OF THE RACK
event.tube_stash_find.title: A Stash Nobody Claimed
event.tube_stash_find.context: Clearing out the back of the rack turned up a box that predates everyone currently working here.
event.tube_stash_find.opt.stash_refurb.o: It goes back into the chain and sounds like itself again.
event.tube_stash_find.opt.stash_sell.out: It leaves the building before lunch.
event.power_surge.title: The Mains Blew
event.power_surge.context: A surge came through the whole floor at once. Nothing is on fire. Several things are no longer working perfectly.
event.power_surge.opt.surge_engineer.out: Everything comes back better isolated than it left.
event.power_surge.opt.surge_ride_it.outc: The desk hums at a slightly different note now.
event.intern_prodigy.title: The One You Least Expected
event.intern_prodigy.context: The newest person on the roster has quietly stopped needing the session explained twice.
event.intern_prodigy.opt.prodigy_own_ses: They run the session. It holds.
They keep watching. They keep getting better.
event.sync_brief_lands.title: A Brief With Your Name On It
event.sync_brief_lands.context: A picture and an advert want a needle drop, they heard your room, and they want it this week.
It airs on schedule. Everyone asks who did the needle drop.
They find someone else, and remember that you were busy.
event.la_label_dropin.kicker: LOS ANGELES // A&R IN THE LOBBY
event.la_label_dropin.title: An A&R Walks In Off Sunset
event.la_label_dropin.context: A label scout was in the building for another room and heard your monitors through the wall. They have twenty minutes and a business card.
event.la_label_dropin.opt.la_play_reel.o: They leave a finder fee on the desk and a promise to call.
event.la_label_dropin.opt.la_hold_slot.l: Keep the booking, offer a rain check
event.la_label_dropin.opt.la_hold_slot.o: Your client notices. The scout writes down the studio name anyway.
event.nashville_songwriter_round.title: A Songwriters’ Round Needs a Room
event.nashville_songwriter_round.context: Four writers want to demo a whole night of songs on a handshake and a tip jar. Whatever you charge, the songs will be good.
event.nashville_songwriter_round.opt.nas: Coffee, a few mics, no invoice.
By midnight there are three songs worth finishing and one you will hum for a week.
Book it as a paid half-day
They pay on the spot and promise to bring friends.
event.london_pirate_radio.kicker: LONDON // THE AERIAL ON THE ROOF
event.london_pirate_radio.title: Pirate Radio Wants an Exclusive
event.london_pirate_radio.context: A pirate station on the twelfth floor next door wants to play your latest session before anyone else has heard it. Quietly, of course.
event.london_pirate_radio.opt.lon_give_i: The phones light up. Your client is flattered and a little annoyed.
event.london_pirate_radio.opt.lon_ask_cl: They say yes with a grin. A smaller splash, a bigger thank-you.
event.berlin_curfew_night.kicker: BERLIN // THE NIGHT THAT DID NOT END
event.berlin_curfew_night.title: The Club Next Door Never Closed
event.berlin_curfew_night.context: The bass from the club next door has been leaking through your live room since midnight. A promoter pokes his head in: want to record the afterparty?
event.berlin_curfew_night.opt.ber_record: You get a hundred minutes of something nobody will ever be able to recreate.
event.berlin_curfew_night.opt.ber_soundp: Pay the promoter in good faith.
The promoter respects it. The bass drops two floors down.
event.tokyo_city_pop_revival.title: A Reissue Label Wants Your Room
event.tokyo_city_pop_revival.context: The owner of the vinyl bar downstairs is reissuing a forgotten record and wants it remastered through your gear. The tapes are in a shoebox.
event.tokyo_city_pop_revival.opt.tok_rem: The tapes sing. The owner bows lower than you expected.
event.tokyo_city_pop_revival.opt.tok_tra: Trade it for a rare fader set
Your console feels newer than it has in a decade.
event.rio_carnival_rehearsal.kicker: RIO // A HUNDRED DRUMS AT THE DOOR
event.rio_carnival_rehearsal.title: A Samba School Brings the Whole Bateria
event.rio_carnival_rehearsal.context: A samba school wants to record its carnival rehearsal in your room. It does not fit. They intend to make it fit.
event.rio_carnival_rehearsal.opt.rio_ful: Open every door and record it all
Mic the street, mic the stairs.
It is the loudest and best thing you have ever put to tape.
event.rio_carnival_rehearsal.opt.rio_sma: Clean, tight, danceable, and the drums still shake the glass.
event.la_session_player_dropin.title: A Session Legend Needs a Room for an Hour
event.la_session_player_dropin.context: A session guitarist who has played on half the records in your collection has an hour free and a cancelled booking across town.
event.la_session_player_dropin.opt.la_sp: Pay their rate and record something
You get a take nobody else in town can play.
Trade the hour for a favour
They shake your hand. The favour is noted in a very small book.
event.la_heatwave_blackout.title: The Heatwave Takes the Power
event.la_heatwave_blackout.context: A brownout rolls across the valley. The air conditioning dies, the racks start to cook and a nervous client sits in the live room.
event.la_heatwave_blackout.opt.la_hw_gen: Everything survives. The client buys lunch.
event.la_heatwave_blackout.opt.la_hw_shu: Cool the room, rebook the day.
Nothing breaks. Nothing gets recorded either.
event.nashville_demo_wall.title: A Wall of Cassettes Falls Off the Shelf
event.nashville_demo_wall.context: Someone leans on the shelf and a decade of unlabelled demos hits the floor. One of the tapes has a song you recognise from the radio.
event.nashville_demo_wall.opt.nash_dw_di: You find three songs worth recording again.
event.nashville_demo_wall.opt.nash_dw_se: Sell the radio one to a publisher
The publisher is delighted. The writer is not.
event.nashville_open_mic.title: The Open Mic Down the Street Wants a Mixer
event.nashville_open_mic.context: The bar around the corner has a famous open mic and a broken board. The owner needs a mixer by seven.
event.nashville_open_mic.opt.nash_om_vol: Fix the board, run the room.
You meet three writers and one future client.
event.nashville_open_mic.opt.nash_om_inv: The owner pays on the nail and offers you a free pint.
event.london_tube_strike.title: The Tube Strike Strands the Band
event.london_tube_strike.context: Half your session is stuck on a platform in zone four. The other half is already in the live room, drinking tea.
event.london_tube_strike.opt.lon_ts_rewo: Re-plan the day around who is here
The day gets stranger and the record gets better.
event.london_tube_strike.opt.lon_ts_cabs: Everyone arrives annoyed. The take that follows is excellent.
event.london_music_press.title: A Writer from the Music Press Wants a Studio Visit
event.london_music_press.context: A weekly music paper wants five hundred words on your room. They also want a quote about your favourite microphone.
The piece runs under a headline you did not choose.
event.berlin_techno_loan.title: The Club Wants to Borrow Your Speakers
event.berlin_techno_loan.context: A club three streets over has blown a stack and the headliner lands at midnight. They offer to rent your monitors for a night.
event.berlin_techno_loan.opt.ber_tl_rent: They come back hot, bass-dusted and perfectly fine.
event.berlin_techno_loan.opt.ber_tl_decl: Say no and keep the room quiet
The promoter respects that and finds a loan elsewhere.
event.berlin_modular_swap.kicker: BERLIN // THE RACK IN THE CORNER
event.berlin_modular_swap.title: A Modular Wizard Offers a Swap
event.berlin_modular_swap.context: A local synth builder with silver rings and no sleep offers a patched-up voice module in exchange for a day of studio time.
event.berlin_modular_swap.opt.ber_ms_swa: Your studio has a new voice and a few new bruises on the patch bay.
event.berlin_modular_swap.opt.ber_ms_cas: Rent them the room for cash
They bring their own cables and leave them behind.
event.tokyo_karaoke_night.title: A Label Throws a Karaoke Night
event.tokyo_karaoke_night.context: A label is looking for a backing-track engineer and has booked you a seat at a very long table.
event.tokyo_karaoke_night.opt.tok_kn_sin: You are terrible. They love you for it.
event.tokyo_karaoke_night.opt.tok_kn_pit: Be the professional in the room.
You leave with a contract and a very strange haircut photo.
event.tokyo_earthquake_drill.title: A Small Quake Shakes the Racks
event.tokyo_earthquake_drill.context: The racks sway and a rack-mount compressor slides a few millimetres off its ears. Nothing falls, but the whole room is thinking about it.
event.tokyo_earthquake_drill.opt.tok_ed_: The racks are quiet and a lot more confident.
It was only a small one.
You get a great take and a cracked hinge.
event.rio_street_party.kicker: RIO // A BLOCK PARTY AT THE DOOR
event.rio_street_party.title: The Street Party Wants Your Console
event.rio_street_party.context: A block party has set up speakers in the street. They would very much like to wheel your mixing desk out to the pavement.
event.rio_street_party.opt.rio_sp_lend.f: Mics in the street, desk on the kerb.
event.rio_street_party.opt.rio_sp_lend.o: You record the best crowd you have ever heard. The desk smells of caipirinha.
event.rio_street_party.opt.rio_sp_mics.l: Send two mics and an engineer
event.rio_street_party.opt.rio_sp_mics.o: You get a hundred friends and a clean multitrack.
event.rio_rainy_season.title: The Roof Starts Singing
event.rio_rainy_season.context: The tropical rain finds a hole in the live room roof and starts a rhythm of its own on the snare drum.
event.rio_rainy_season.opt.rio_rs_repair: Dry, tidy and a little sad.
event.rio_rainy_season.opt.rio_rs_record: Record the rain as an instrument
It ends up on three records and a ringtone.
event.saga_la_1.kicker: LOS ANGELES // THE REEL IN THE WALL (1/3)
event.saga_la_1.title: A Tape Behind the Plaster
event.saga_la_1.context: Rewiring the control room, an electrician finds a reel of tape sealed in the wall with a date from decades ago.
event.saga_la_1.opt.saga_la_1_a.label: Play it before anyone else hears
event.saga_la_1.opt.saga_la_1_a.flavor: You thread it up alone, after midnight.
event.saga_la_1.opt.saga_la_1_a.outcome: Faint, warm, unmistakable. Someone very good once played in this room.
event.saga_la_1.opt.saga_la_1_b.label: Hand it to a restoration lab
event.saga_la_1.opt.saga_la_1_b.flavor: Do it properly and pay for it.
event.saga_la_1.opt.saga_la_1_b.outcome: The lab calls it a find and promises a clean transfer.
event.saga_la_2.kicker: LOS ANGELES // THE REEL IN THE WALL (2/3)
event.saga_la_2.title: Whose Voice Is on the Reel?
event.saga_la_2.context: The transfer is back. A singer, a band that never released a thing, and a name scrawled on the box.
event.saga_la_2.opt.saga_la_2_a.label: Track down the family
event.saga_la_2.opt.saga_la_2_a.flavor: Letters, phone calls, an afternoon in an archive.
event.saga_la_2.opt.saga_la_2_a.outcome: A granddaughter cries on the phone, then asks you to come to dinner.
event.saga_la_2.opt.saga_la_2_b.label: Keep it quiet and keep the tape
event.saga_la_2.opt.saga_la_2_b.flavor: Some things are better left in the vault.
event.saga_la_2.opt.saga_la_2_b.outcome: The tape goes in a drawer. The drawer feels heavier.
event.saga_la_3.kicker: LOS ANGELES // THE REEL IN THE WALL (3/3)
event.saga_la_3.title: The Reel Gets Its Release
event.saga_la_3.context: Word has spread. A reissue label wants the tape and the story of the room that kept it.
event.saga_la_3.opt.saga_la_3_a.label: Release it with the family
event.saga_la_3.opt.saga_la_3_a.flavor: Split the credit and the proceeds fairly.
event.saga_la_3.opt.saga_la_3_a.outcome: The reissue sells out. Your name is in the liner notes, near theirs.
event.saga_la_3.opt.saga_la_3_b.label: License it outright
event.saga_la_3.opt.saga_la_3_b.flavor: Take the cheque and thank them kindly.
event.saga_la_3.opt.saga_la_3_b.outcome: It pays well. The family never quite writes back.
event.saga_nashville_1.title: A Chorus Without Verses
event.saga_nashville_1.context: A weathered songwriter leaves a cassette on your desk: one perfect chorus, no verses, no name.
event.saga_nashville_1.opt.saga_nashvill: Sit with it until it talks.
By morning you have three verses. None feel like yours.
Somebody on Music Row will know.
Four different people recognise it. All four give a different name.
event.saga_nashville_2.title: The Songwriter Comes Back
event.saga_nashville_2.context: They are in the lobby, older than the tape suggested, and slightly offended you changed a word.
event.saga_nashville_2.opt.saga_nashvill: Let them rewrite it in the room
Give them the good mic and the afternoon.
The new lyric is plainer and much, much better.
They leave unconvinced, but the demo gets airplay.
event.saga_nashville_3.title: A Cover from the Top of the Charts
event.saga_nashville_3.context: A chart-topping act wants to cut the song. The songwriter has one condition: your room.
event.saga_nashville_3.opt.saga_nashvill: Record it all in your room
Take the session and the spotlight.
It goes to number one. The songwriter sends a handwritten card.
Step back and take a credit in the notes
The credit is a single line. People in town read it twice.
event.saga_london_1.title: A Pirate Signal Reaches the Roof
event.saga_london_1.context: Your aerial picks up a pirate station playing nothing but demos, and the DJ keeps naming your street.
Climb up and trace the signal
A cheap transmitter, a stolen car battery, and a note addressed to the studio.
If they like unknown music, send them some.
It is on air within the hour.
event.saga_london_2.title: The DJ Asks to Meet
event.saga_london_2.context: The voice behind the station turns up with a thermos, two crates of tapes and a problem with the regulator.
Hide the crates until the heat passes
The crates rest under your tape shelf. Nobody knocks.
They hate the paperwork and love the signal.
event.saga_london_3.title: A Legal Licence and a Live Session
event.saga_london_3.context: The station goes legal. The first broadcast is a live session in your room.
By week three the queue of bands reaches the stairs.
Do it once, do it brilliantly
It trends for a day and is quoted for a year.
event.saga_berlin_1.title: A Key to a Concrete Door
event.saga_berlin_1.context: A promoter hands you a key to a cold bunker and says the acoustics are unreal.
Bring a field recorder and go
The reverb tail lasts eleven seconds. You clap and listen to it ring.
Send an assistant and stay in the studio
Someone has to mind the desk.
The recording comes back muddy but full of promise.
event.saga_berlin_2.title: The Bunker Wants a Residency
event.saga_berlin_2.context: The promoter wants a monthly night. The crowd shows up before the sound system does.
Rig the room with your own gear
The first night, you hear the room before the music starts.
Rent them a system and stay home
Cheques arrive on time. The night still sounds wonderful.
event.saga_berlin_3.title: The Bunker Album
event.saga_berlin_3.context: A live album from the bunker is being cut. Press want a cover and a story.
Put the studio name on the front.
The review calls it the sound of a concrete cathedral.
Let the venue take the credit
You are in the credits. You are not on the cover.
event.saga_tokyo_1.title: A Jazz Cafe Is Closing
event.saga_tokyo_1.context: A tiny cafe with a legendary record collection is closing at the end of the month. The owner says you can choose three.
event.saga_tokyo_1.opt.saga_tokyo_1_a.la: Pick three and record the owner talking
event.saga_tokyo_1.opt.saga_tokyo_1_a.fl: Preserve the voice as well as the vinyl.
event.saga_tokyo_1.opt.saga_tokyo_1_a.ou: Ninety minutes of stories about every record on the wall.
event.saga_tokyo_1.opt.saga_tokyo_1_b.fl: Too much to lose to a stranger.
event.saga_tokyo_1.opt.saga_tokyo_1_b.ou: The shelves arrive in a van. The whole room smells of old paper.
event.saga_tokyo_2.title: One Last Night of Music
event.saga_tokyo_2.context: The owner asks for one live night with the regulars, and wants it recorded properly.
event.saga_tokyo_2.opt.saga_tokyo_2_a.fl: Dedicated mics and a full multitrack.
event.saga_tokyo_2.opt.saga_tokyo_2_a.ou: Forty people, one piano, no applause until the last chord fades.
event.saga_tokyo_2.opt.saga_tokyo_2_b.fl: Let the night be a night.
event.saga_tokyo_2.opt.saga_tokyo_2_b.ou: You sit in the back with the owner and drink the last cup.
event.saga_tokyo_3.title: The Records Get a Second Home
event.saga_tokyo_3.context: A label wants to build a listening room around the collection. They want your studio involved.
event.saga_tokyo_3.opt.saga_tokyo_3_a.fl: Share the shelves with the public.
event.saga_tokyo_3.opt.saga_tokyo_3_a.ou: The new listening room opens with a queue around the block.
event.saga_tokyo_3.opt.saga_tokyo_3_b.la: Sell the story, keep the vinyl
event.saga_tokyo_3.opt.saga_tokyo_3_b.fl: A generous fee, a private shelf.
event.saga_tokyo_3.opt.saga_tokyo_3_b.ou: The story sells beautifully. The vinyl stays yours.
event.saga_rio_1.title: A Tape from Last Year
event.saga_rio_1.context: A samba teacher brings a rehearsal tape from last year, ruined by a leaking roof, and asks if anything can be saved.
event.saga_rio_1.opt.saga_rio_1_a.label: Bake the tape and try
event.saga_rio_1.opt.saga_rio_1_a.flavor: Eight hours in a low oven, fingers crossed.
event.saga_rio_1.opt.saga_rio_1_a.outcom: It plays for ninety seconds before it dies. They are the best ninety seconds you have heard.
event.saga_rio_1.opt.saga_rio_1_b.label: Rebuild it from memory
event.saga_rio_1.opt.saga_rio_1_b.outcom: They remember every beat, and add a few new ones.
event.saga_rio_2.title: The Drummers Want a Proper Album
event.saga_rio_2.context: The whole school wants the rebuilt song on an album, in time for carnival.
event.saga_rio_2.opt.saga_rio_2_a.label: Rush to finish before carnival
event.saga_rio_2.opt.saga_rio_2_a.outcom: You finish at dawn, the same hour the parade begins to form.
event.saga_rio_2.opt.saga_rio_2_b.label: Take the season, release after
event.saga_rio_2.opt.saga_rio_2_b.outcom: They are impatient but proud, and the final mix is stunning.
event.saga_rio_3.title: The Parade Plays Your Record
event.saga_rio_3.context: The song opens the parade. Half the city hears it from a truck, a window and a bar.
event.saga_rio_3.opt.saga_rio_3_a.label: Join the parade with the mixing desk
event.saga_rio_3.opt.saga_rio_3_a.outcom: You push a flight case through the crowd and no one is annoyed.
event.saga_rio_3.opt.saga_rio_3_b.label: Watch from the roof with a thermos
event.saga_rio_3.opt.saga_rio_3_b.flavor: The best seat in the city.
event.saga_rio_3.opt.saga_rio_3_b.outcom: You hear your own mix a block away and it holds up.
event.client_rush_request.title: Can You Turn It Around Faster?
event.client_rush_request.context: {{label}} is back with a deadline that has moved up. They are asking whether you can deliver in half the usual time.
event.client_rush_request.opt.rush_accep: Long nights, rush fee on the invoice.
You shake on it. The diary gets tight.
event.client_rush_request.opt.rush_reduc: They grumble, then agree that less, done well, beats more, done badly.
event.client_rush_payoff.title: The Rush Job Landed
event.client_rush_payoff.context: {{label}} just heard how the rushed release went. They are delighted, and they want you to know it.
event.client_rush_payoff.opt.payoff_than: They tell people the studio delivers when it counts.
event.client_rush_payoff.opt.payoff_disc: Offer a discount on their next booking
They book the next session before leaving the room.
event.client_rush_fallout.title: The Rush Job Stumbled
event.client_rush_fallout.context: The rushed release for {{label}} shows its seams. They are not angry, but they are being careful with you now.
event.client_rush_fallout.opt.fallout_re: The reworked version is better. The trust comes back slowly.
event.client_rush_fallout.opt.fallout_ex: Explain the constraints and move on
Fair, and cold. They book elsewhere for a while.
event.client_rush_respected.title: They Understood
event.client_rush_respected.context: {{label}} did not hold the declined rush against you. They would like to make sure it stays that way.
event.client_rush_respected.opt.respecte: The note goes up on their studio wall.
So the next rush is easier.
You have a regular, and they know it.
event.client_referral_ask.title: A Friend of a Friend
event.client_referral_ask.context: {{label}} has been singing your praises. They can introduce you to someone bigger, or put their name behind the studio in public.
event.client_referral_ask.opt.referral_t: A new name appears in the booking diary.
event.client_referral_ask.opt.referral_c: Put the studio’s name on the sleeve.
The credit line is small, and it opens doors.
event.studio_label_scout.title: A Label Scout Stops By
event.studio_label_scout.context: A scout from a larger label is in the building “just for the coffee”. They are listening to everything.
Let the room make its case.
The scout leaves with a notebook full of names, and yours is on the first page.
event.studio_label_scout.opt.scout_priva: Word gets round that the studio protects its artists.
event.studio_press_inquiry.title: The Press Wants a Word
event.studio_press_inquiry.context: A trade journalist wants ten minutes about how the studio works. It could be flattering. It could be long.
event.studio_press_inquiry.opt.press_tal: Open the doors, put the kettle on.
The piece runs with a good photograph of the console.
event.studio_press_inquiry.opt.press_sta: A brief mention, and a brief silence.
event.staff_artist_conflict.title: An Argument in the Live Room
event.staff_artist_conflict.context: {{label}} and a visiting artist disagree loudly about a take. Both think they are right.
event.staff_artist_conflict.opt.conflict: You hired them for a reason.
The crew member stands a little taller. The artist sulks through lunch.
A cup of tea, a fresh take.
Both walk out with a better take than either planned.
event.gear_overheated.title: It Ran Hot
event.gear_overheated.context: The {{label}} has been running all week and something smells warm. It survived, but only just.
event.gear_overheated.opt.gear_service.o: The technician finds and fixes two other problems.
event.gear_overheated.opt.gear_fan.label: Put a fan on it and carry on
event.wren_1.kicker: WREN CALLOWAY // THE CLIENT WHO FOLLOWED (1/4)
event.wren_1.title: The Girl with the Borrowed Guitar
event.wren_1.context: A teenager called Wren Calloway turns up with a borrowed guitar and two songs she wrote on the bus. She says she is moving on to another city next month and wants something to take with her.
event.wren_1.opt.wren_1_a.label: Give her a free afternoon
event.wren_1.opt.wren_1_a.outcome: Two songs in four takes. She leaves with an acetate and writes your address on her hand.
event.wren_1.opt.wren_1_b.label: Book her at the cheap rate
event.wren_1.opt.wren_1_b.outcome: She pays in coins and thanks you twice.
event.wren_2.kicker: WREN CALLOWAY // THE CLIENT WHO FOLLOWED (2/4)
event.wren_2.title: Wren Calloway, Now With Synthesisers
event.wren_2.context: Years on and a different city on the postmark, Wren walks in with a drum machine under one arm. She remembers the acetate. She wants to record something that sounds nothing like it.
event.wren_2.opt.wren_2_a.label: Let her take over the room for a week
event.wren_2.opt.wren_2_a.flavor: She wants to experiment, so let her.
event.wren_2.opt.wren_2_a.outcome: Seven days, one record, a lot of fingerprints on the desk. It sounds like the future.
event.wren_2.opt.wren_2_b.label: Keep it to a tight three-day session
event.wren_2.opt.wren_2_b.outcome: Three days, four songs, a neat invoice and a happy artist.
event.wren_3.kicker: WREN CALLOWAY // THE CLIENT WHO FOLLOWED (3/4)
event.wren_3.title: Wren Puts the Record Online
event.wren_3.context: Wren has self-released and the downloads are climbing. A label has noticed and wants the masters. She calls from yet another time zone to ask what you think.
event.wren_3.opt.wren_3_a.label: Tell her to stay independent
event.wren_3.opt.wren_3_a.flavor: Keep the masters, keep the story.
event.wren_3.opt.wren_3_a.outcome: She turns the label down and credits your room in the thread. It trends for a weekend.
event.wren_3.opt.wren_3_b.label: Help her negotiate a fair deal
event.wren_3.opt.wren_3_b.outcome: You mark up the contract together. The final version is the first one she is proud to sign.
event.wren_4.kicker: WREN CALLOWAY // THE CLIENT WHO FOLLOWED (4/4)
event.wren_4.title: Wren Calloway, Last Chorus
event.wren_4.context: Wren is a veteran now, with a catalogue and a quiet tour bus. Her farewell album is the last thing on her list, and she wants to cut it in the room where the first acetate was made.
event.wren_4.opt.wren_4_a.label: Close the studio for her and tell the story
event.wren_4.opt.wren_4_a.flavor: Let the room be part of the record.
event.wren_4.opt.wren_4_a.outcome: The album opens with the sound of your door closing. The reviews quote it.
event.wren_4.opt.wren_4_b.label: Record it quietly and keep the credit small
event.wren_4.opt.wren_4_b.flavor: A small credit, a long friendship.
event.wren_4.opt.wren_4_b.outcome: It is the best session of her career. Your name is in the notes, in small print, and she sends a card.
